privacy.text: In this context, it does not mean that a temporary email address guarantees privacy, anonymity, or security.
- You understand that temporary email does not guarantee anonymity.

Email is a tool for talking to people and organisations you trust. Treat your main address as something valuable, and hand it out only when the relationship deserves it. For everything else, a temporary address gives you what you came for and leaves nothing behind. Used with a little judgement, it protects your inbox, your time and your attention.
